title: Cross incoming
text: The other team is about to cross. Their striker is next to you in the box.
tip: In your own box, the striker is your job.

options.text: Run out to block the crosser
options.why: That leaves the striker free right in front of goal.
You might win it, but the striker can sneak in front of you.

options.text: Get between the striker and goal, watch both
options.why: From there you can attack the ball and the striker can't get in front of you.
